summary_table.subtitle: NY postpartum preeclampsia admissions are rising as a distinct maternity issue

reimbursement_policies.evidence: The policy does not name or price this postpartum/postabortion DRG category; it governs inpatient readmission reimbursement. For New York Medicaid, an unplanned readmission within 14 days for the same or closely related condition or procedure is not separately reimbursed when it occurs to the same or a different hospital within the same hospital system. Obstetrical deliveries are excluded, so postpartum/postabortion cases are implicated only if they are not treated as delivery admissions.

pairing_conditions: same or different hospital within same system
state_specific_rules: NY Medicaid: 14-day readmission window; same or closely related condition or procedure; same or different hospital within the same hospital system; planned readmissions excluded.
exemptions: transfers from one acute care hospital to another

reimbursement_policies.evidence: The policy does not cite the requested maternity DRG category or postpartum preeclampsia specifically. For New York inpatient claims paid under DRG methodology, unplanned readmissions within 14 days to the same or a different hospital in the same hospital system for the same, similar, or related condition or procedure are not separately reimbursed unless an exclusion applies. Obstetrical deliveries are generally excluded, but postpartum or postabortion readmissions are not separately listed as excluded in the New York rule.

pairing_conditions: same or different hospital same system
state_specific_rules: NY: same or closely related condition or procedure triggers review.
NY: no separate reimbursement for readmission to same or different hospital within same hospital system for same, similar, or related condition.
NY: no postpartum-specific exclusion is listed.
exemptions: transfers from one acute care hospital to another
member discharged from the hospital against medical advice
infants less than 12 months of age

recommended_action.description: Recommendation 1: For DRG/Medicaid inpatient readmissions, apply the deny only to returns 'within 14 days of discharge' / '14 days from discharge' for the 'same or closely related condition' at the 'same or different hospital within same system,' and explicitly carve out 'obstetrical deliveries' and 'planned readmissions' so cesarean-delivery and related postpartum maternity stays are not swept into the edit. Exempt: obstetrical deliveries, planned readmissions.
